```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
# ---- Functions ----
rdirichlet <- function(n, alpha) {
  g <- matrix(rgamma(n * length(alpha), shape = alpha), n, byrow = TRUE)
  g / rowSums(g)
}
 
minnesota_cons <- function(p) (p^2 / 10) / (1:p)^2
 
is_stationary <- function(phi) all(Mod(polyroot(c(1, -phi))) > 1)
 
# Generative (process) R2: phi' R(phi) phi = sum(phi_i * rho_i)
r2_gen <- function(phi) sum(phi * ARMAacf(ar = phi, lag.max = length(phi))[-1])
 
# One-step-ahead Bayes R2 given a lag correlation matrix C (var_y = 1)
r2_bayes <- function(phi, sigma2, C) {
  s <- drop(t(phi) %*% C %*% phi)
  s / (s + sigma2)
}
 
# Observed lag autocorrelation matrix
C_obs <- function(y, p) toeplitz(acf(y, lag.max = p - 1, plot = FALSE)$acf[1:p])
 
draw_prior <- function(n, p, a, b, cons) {
  R2    <- rbeta(n, a, b)
  psi   <- if (p == 1) matrix(1, n, 1) else rdirichlet(n, cons)
  z     <- matrix(rnorm(n * p), n, p)
  u     <- sqrt(psi) * z
  list(R2 = R2, u = u, phi = sqrt(R2) * u, sigma2 = 1 - R2)
}
 
# ---- Data ----
 
y <- as.numeric(scale(read.csv("simdata/ar_sim.csv", header = FALSE)[[1]]))
 
# ---- Configs ----
 
n_draws <- 1e5
p_grid  <- c(1, 2, 5)
 
configs <- list(
  list(label = "flat, R2 mean 1/3",  mean = 1/3, prec = 3, cons = function(p) rep(1, p)),
  list(label = "Minn., R2 mean 1/3", mean = 1/3, prec = 3, cons = minnesota_cons),
  list(label = "flat, R2 mean 2/3",  mean = 2/3, prec = 9, cons = function(p) rep(1, p)),
  list(label = "Minn., R2 mean 2/3", mean = 2/3, prec = 9, cons = minnesota_cons)
)
 
# ---- Loop ----
 
set.seed(1)
 
draws <- map_dfr(p_grid, function(p) {
  C <- C_obs(y, p)
  map_dfr(configs, function(cfg) {
    a <- cfg$mean * cfg$prec
    b <- (1 - cfg$mean) * cfg$prec
    d <- draw_prior(n_draws, p, a, b, cfg$cons(p))
 
    stat  <- apply(d$phi, 1, is_stationary)
    rgen  <- rep(NA_real_, n_draws)
    rgen[stat] <- apply(d$phi[stat, , drop = FALSE], 1, r2_gen)
    rbay  <- vapply(seq_len(n_draws),
                    function(i) r2_bayes(d$phi[i, ], d$sigma2[i], C), numeric(1))
 
    tibble(
      config     = cfg$label,
      p          = p,
      knob       = d$R2,
      skew_only  = d$R2 * rowSums(d$u^2),
      stationary = stat,
      r2_gen     = rgen,
      r2_bayes   = rbay
    )
  })
})
 
# ---- Summaries ----
 
summ <- draws %>%
  group_by(config, p) %>%
  summarise(
    # fill in
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```
